description: SvSplitter in Svelte 5: two resizable panes with a draggable WAI-ARIA separator. Drag the gutter or focus it and use the arrow keys, with Home and End jumping to the min and max bounds set as fractions; splitters nest, so a horizontal split holding a vertical one gives an IDE layout, and dir='rtl' flips the horizontal drag direction.

faq.question: How is the split size expressed?
faq.answer: As a fraction of the container from 0 to 1 through fraction and onChange, with min and max as fractions too, so the layout is independent of pixel size.

faq.question: How do I build a three-pane layout?
faq.answer: Nest a vertical SvSplitter inside one pane of a horizontal one; each keeps its own fraction, which is how the demo gets a sidebar plus an editor over a console.

faq.question: Is the separator keyboard accessible?
faq.answer: Yes. It is a separator role with aria-valuenow, focusable by Tab, and arrow keys resize in small steps while Home and End go to the bounds.
